costs.note: Assumption, not a measured constant. Verified impact is the constant-product move of this fill's SOL into the pool's SOL reserve: 10000 * dx / (pool + dx). Jupiter priceImpactPct is stored as impact_pct and is not used. On 28 Oct 2026 the open pools of 148.27, 179.79 and 257.14 SOL carried Jupiter impacts of 2.49%, 1.24% and 1.09%. The same 0.5 SOL ticket against those reserves is 0.336%, 0.277% and 0.194%. Quoted outAmount across three sizes sits on that curve: the mid size predicted from the other two matched within 0.02% on the pools whose vault did not move during the read. The Jupiter field is a gap versus a cached USD price. Per side: base_bps + impact_weight * verified_impact_bps, plus stress_exit_bps on hard_stop, trailing_stop and liquidity_pulled, capped at max_bps. A missing reserve adds no impact term. Charged on entry and on exit. Skip, exit, kill, void, and the v6.5 freeze are unchanged.

rules.rule: Fixed 0.5 SOL paper entry from a Jupiter quote; F max 4 open, 8 new/day; R and S capped at 2x F fills
Stop -25%, take +40%/+100% (1/3 each), trail 25% after first take, time stop 120 min unless up 10%, liquidity pull 40%, -100% after 3 no-route checks
No new entries when data failures > 10% today or after a loop outage > 2h
